topic: What time does the last train from Glasgow Central to Edinburgh leave on a Saturday?

text:
Sat 5th thinking we do edinburgh for the night? 🍻 need to know last train from central to edinburgh so we dont miss it

@claude what time does the last train from glasgow central to edinburgh leave on a saturday?

I couldn't confirm the last Saturday train for the 5th. The results mostly showed weekday times, around 23:06 to 23:30. One Edinburgh News article said Saturday last trains had been cut to about 10:15pm, but I couldn't tell how recent it was. Check the ScotRail journey planner for the 5th before you go, because engineering work can also change the trains.

https://www.scotrail.co.uk/train-times/glasgow-central-to-edinburgh-waverley
